issuer: the Road Safety Authority, the licensing authority
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Irish Statute Book (the Office of the Attorney General). The Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 537/2006) as amended by the Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2011 (S.I. 483/2011, in operation from 19 January 2013), which replaced Regulation 9 and Regulation 10(2): 17 is the age below which a person is disqualified from holding a driving licence or a learner permit for category B, and the Road Traffic (Licensing of Learner Drivers) (Certificates of Competency) Regulations 2007 (S.I. 725/2007, in operation from 30 October 2007) bar a person granted a first learner permit for category B from applying for a certificate of competency (the driving test) within 6 months of the permit coming into force (S.I. 509/2010 lifted this only for holders of a foreign full licence, S.I. 3/2012 only for category EB), so the earliest full licence comes at 17 and a half, held here as from 17, the whole age; a licence for category B granted to someone under 60 is for 10 years plus the unexpired period of a licence held before (the unexpired part not held). The Amendment Regulations 2013 (S.I. 6/2013) made the Road Safety Authority the licensing authority, retaining the fees. The Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) (Fees) Regulations 2024 (S.I. 673/2024, in operation from 1 January 2025, revoking those of 2020) set the fee for a 10-year (or longer than 3-year) driving licence at €65 (a learner permit €45, not held). The Irish Statute Book publishes statutory instruments as made, not consolidated: no instrument after S.I. 673/2024 changing these fees was found, and the age and term are as S.I. 483/2011 set them, with no later change to Regulations 9 and 10 found. The National Driver Licence Service's own site answered a Cloudflare check and was not read. No identity card is held (the RSA's public services card isn't its), and no exchange list was read. The learner permit changes said to take effect on 1 November 2026 (a cap on the number of permits) touch neither the full licence's age, its fee nor its term. Held from 18 (the lead, 2026-10-30): 17 and the six months on a first learner permit S.I. 725/2007 asks before the test make 17 and a half, rounded up as the Northern Territory's eighteen and a half is.

sources.title: S.I. No. 483/2011, Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2011 (Irish Statute Book)
sources.said: These Regulations come into operation on 19 January 2013. ... the age set out in column (2) of the Table below opposite the mention of a vehicle category in column (1) of the Table is the age below which a person is disqualified from holding a driving licence or a learner permit in respect of vehicles of that category. ... B, BE 17 ... in the case of an applicant less than 60 years of age on the commencement day, for a licence to drive vehicles of category A, A1, A2, AM, B, BE or W, 10 years plus the unexpired period of a licence previously granted to the applicant

sources.title: S.I. No. 6/2013, Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) (Amendment) Regulations 2013 (Irish Statute Book)
sources.said: The Road Safety Authority may retain any fees received by it under these Regulations in discharge of its functions as the licensing authority.

sources.title: S.I. No. 673/2024, Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) (Fees) Regulations 2024 (Irish Statute Book)
sources.said: These Regulations come into operation on 1 January 2025. ... The Road Traffic (Licensing of Drivers) (Fees) Regulations 2020 (S. I. No. 75 of 2020) are revoked. ... 10 year (or a period greater than 3 years) driving licence 65

sources.title: S.I. No. 725/2007, Road Traffic (Licensing of Learner Drivers) (Certificates of Competency) Regulations 2007 (Irish Statute Book)
sources.said: These Regulations come into operation on 30 October 2007. ... A person who after the commencement of these Regulations is granted a learner permit for a vehicle in category A, A1, M, W, B or EB by a licensing authority and has not previously held, within the period of 5 years prior to the granting, such a permit in that category, is not entitled to make an application for a certificate of competency to an issuing authority within the period of 6 months from the day the permit comes into force.

sources.title: S.I. No. 509/2010, Road Traffic (Licensing of Learner Drivers) (Certificates of Competency) (Amendment) Regulations 2010 (Irish Statute Book)
sources.said: These Regulations remove the requirement to hold a learner permit for at least six months before sitting a driving test from holders of full driving licences from other jurisdictions.

sources.title: S.I. No. 3/2012 (Irish Statute Book)
sources.said: The purpose of these Regulations is remove from learner drivers in category EB (car with trailer) the requirement to wait six months before taking a driving test in that category.
